correctness.rationale: Independent reimplementation confirms all essential computations. Pure-dimer baselines 6728, 31529, 167089, 817991, 4213133 for N=6..10 match Kasteleyn/Temperley-Fisher product formula (ceil(m/2)xceil(n/2) cosine product rounds exactly, including 4x4=36 and 2x6=13 controls) and an independently written column-DP. Full 762-orbit CSV rechecked with a separately coded DP: 762/762 match, zero mismatches; C=Z/Z(empty) recomputed, all Z>0 with minima 360 (N=6), 907 (N=7), 6134 (N=8), 17409 (N=9), 90117 (N=10). Brute-force backtracking with no transfer matrix matches 4 sampled N=6 orbits including max (0,0)-(0,1)=3364 and min 360. Exact Bareiss integer determinants on 5 samples (pure 6x6, max pairs, bulk pair, hole counterexample) equal CRT determinants, Pf=isqrt(det) with Pf*Pf==det and Pf==DP. Orbit enumeration independently recounted via explicit Klein-4/D4 group action: 45,123,156,198,240 (total 762), canonical sorted, opposite-colour, unique per N. Per-graph Kasteleyn solving verified: GF(2) odd-clockwise system solved and face-oddness asserted on samples; fixed inherited orientation audit-pattern fails exactly as claimed on 6x6 minus (1,1),(4,4) with two even 8-faces (4 clockwise) at indices 1 and 16, proving the correction lemma. Parity zeros are theorem (even board: single deletion leaves odd cells; same-colour pair leaves colour imbalance) plus DP spot checks; all opposite-colour orbits have Z>0. Maxima unique per N (1 maximizer each) at adjacent-corner pairs with C=0.5, 0.5368391005, 0.5126549324, 0.5279018962, 0.5180007372 recomputed. Temperley cross-check verified: trees==dimers 4=4,15=15,192=192 for (2,2),(2,3),(3,3) and trees(6x6)=32565539635200. Witnesses independently validated: 5/5 edge-occupancy pass (every non-monomer vertex degree 1, dominoes on graph edges, correct count) and symmetric difference is exactly 2+2 dominoes forming a unit square (e.g. N=6 square (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) h2v). CRT exactness holds because product ~1e35 >> actual dets ~1e13 (Pf~4e6) and DP bound confirms no modular wrap. Proof vs evidence distinguished: parity zeros and Kasteleyn/Temperley theorems are proofs; all positive Z values are doubly-certified computations (Pfaffian+DP agreement), not analytic theorems; no thermodynamic-limit or flip-connectivity classification is claimed.

originality.rationale: Live retrieval (arXiv 13 hits; Crossref 50901 hits) surfaced the nearest prior results and all were retrieved and inspected. Giuliani-Jauslin-Lieb (1510.05027) proves a Pfaffian formula only for boundary monomers and deduces fermionic boundary correlations; bulk interior pairs are explicitly excluded, so it cannot give per-orbit bulk centre-vs-corner tables for 6xN. Allegra-Fortin (1402.5512) gives a quadratic-fermionic product-of-two-Pfaffians for n fixed monomers and evaluates bulk correlations numerically/continuously, publishing no exact per-position integer census for 6xN N=6-10. Oh (1901.07847) develops state-matrix recursion for monomer-dimer counts/Hosoya index/Aztec octagons, using transfer recursion not Kasteleyn-signed Pfaffian certificates and without 6xN symmetry-orbit stratification or Temperley cross-check. Wu (cond-mat/0607647) rederives the Tzeng-Wu single boundary-monomer solution as nonzero Kasteleyn eigenvalues, single boundary monomer only. Textbook Kasteleyn/Temperley-Fisher gives only Z(N,empty) product formula. No source publishes exact per-(N,pair) integer census for 6xN N=6-10 over all symmetry-inequivalent opposite-colour orbits with per-graph solved-and-verified Kasteleyn Pfaffian plus independent DP agreement plus unique max-correlation witness plus correction lemma. Centre-vs-corner bulk contrast as citable data is new.

value.rationale: Independently worth finding later as a citable benchmark, not a textbook restatement or mere parameter substitution. Textbook gives only pure-dimer product Z(N,empty); boundary-single-monomer Pfaffians (Tzeng-Wu/Wu, Giuliani-Jauslin-Lieb) cover only boundary monomers; Allegra-Fortin gives formalism with bulk numerics not exact tables; Oh gives recursion for different regions. The deliverable beyond raw counting is: (i) complete symmetry-orbit stratification (762 orbits) with per-graph Kasteleyn certificate standard (Pf^2=det) plus 762/762 independent DP agreement, directly usable to test samplers and correlation conjectures; (ii) discovered regularity that the unique maximizer of C(N,u,v) is the adjacent-corner pair for all N=6..10 with exact ratios, a non-trivial edge-effect pattern inviting larger-N conjecture; (iii) correction lemma documenting that the naive inherited Kasteleyn orientation fails on separated-hole faces (explicit 8-face counterexample), a methodological pitfall lesson preventing silent errors; (iv) honest-scope Temperley cross-check and parity documentation with validated flip witnesses. Rejection categories addressed: not textbook (bulk pair tables absent from textbooks), not mere 6xN substitution (orbit reduction, certificates, witnesses), not tiny gain (full census + maximizer pattern, not epsilon improvement), not unexplained enumeration (every number certified, witnesses with occupancy+flip logs, limitations N<=10/no asymptotics/no full flip-graph classification stated). Small-N benchmark scope is stated, not oversold.

residual_risks: Bulk two-monomer exact tables could exist in grey literature or theses not indexed by arXiv/Crossref; queries found no such table but cannot prove universal absence.
CRT exactness relies on DP-bound argument that true det < product (~1e35); validated post-hoc by 762/762 DP agreement and Bareiss spot checks, but full 762-orbit Bareiss verification was not run.
